remarks: Just steps away from everything! This charming unit is minutes from town, shops, restaurants, and the train station. Freshly painted and move-in ready, it features a spacious eat-in kitchen with granite countertops, a brand-new dishwasher, and a refrigerator. Step out onto a generously sized deck directly from the kitchen. Elegant molding details add character throughout. Enjoy the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. A lower-level basement provides extra storage if needed. Private parking is available at the rear of the home, along with a designated garden area for those who love to plant. Area rugs are required to protect the flooring. No pets allowed.
